local_disk_incident.cause_observed: A user CloudKit temporary download repeatedly consumed about 17 GiB and pushed startup volume free space below the 20 GiB browser admission floor.
local_disk_incident.remediation: Stopped the user CloudKit process, disabled its user launchd service temporarily, and removed only its closed temporary cache file. No cloud document was deleted.
local_disk_incident.current_user_service_state: com.apple.cloudd disabled in user launchd; requires restoration after the large download/storage issue is resolved
local_disk_incident.rationale: Restoring immediately had already redownloaded the same large cache and reduced free space to about 1.5 GiB.

limits: This verifies development installation and reload only; no product feature, Store-installed behavior, or overall health claim.
